name: brand_kit_create_template
description: Write ONE brand-kit content template from EXACTLY ONE source: example images (creation_ids), the user's description (brief), or a saved preset (preset_id). Waits inline and returns the finished template, or a run_id to poll. @see guides_get('brand-kit')

brief.description: The user's own description of the content type, max 2000 chars.

channel.description: Full content type the user named (`Instagram Story`, `YouTube Thumbnail`). Never a platform-only word (`Instagram`, `YouTube`). Overrides detection.

creation_ids.description: Up to 25 identifiers of images the user attached themselves.

name_hint.description: What the user called it, max 80 chars; overrides the generated name.

wait_seconds.description: Inline wait before falling back to polling. Default 20.
